name: Digital and Business Economics
summary: Research studies how digital technologies, platforms, financial innovation, and business decisions reshape organizations, markets, work, and economic opportunity.
overview: Current work considers digital government, fintech adoption and inclusion, and how organizations communicate policies and compete in changing markets.

projects.title: Impact of Government Digitalization on Business: Evidence from Estonia’s Digital Transformation
projects.summary: Uses a synthetic-control design to examine whether Estonia’s e-government transformation translated into measurable business and economic benefits.

projects.title: Bridging the Fintech Gap: Regulatory Frictions and Active Financial Inclusion in an Emerging Economy
projects.summary: Uses stakeholder interviews to investigate why Mexico’s developed fintech infrastructure has not yet produced broad financial inclusion.
